We help businesses in Kent achieve the following ISO standards

AS9100 / ISO9001 – Quality Management Systems

ISO9001 is the ‘starting’ standard for many businesses. Considered to be the gold standard for effective quality management, ISO9001 proves to your stakeholders that your products and services will always exceed their expectations. Achieving this certification involves adjusting your systems and processes to reflect best practices and changing your culture so that your teams continually strive for improvement in all areas of their work. It will give stakeholders renewed confidence in your capabilities and provide you with a competitive edge when it comes to securing new projects.

ISO14001 – Environmental Management

This standard won’t just raise your awareness of sustainability initiatives and current eco regulations. Armed with greater knowledge of environmental practices, and a more robust understanding of environmental risks, ISO14001 will help you reduce your carbon footprint, minimise wastage, and engage your teams in your wider ‘green’ goals. Perhaps just as importantly, having ISO14001 to your name will also improve your reputation amongst stakeholders who are increasingly concerned about the environmental impact of their business activities.

ISO27001 – Information Security / GDPR

With new ways of working come different risks. This is certainly true in the digital era, when data is one of our greatest business assets. As a responsible company, you must make sure you have a suitable Information Technology Security System in place that has been carefully designed to protect your IT systems against breaches, hacks, and malicious attacks – all of which could compromise your information, and greatly damage your corporate reputation.

ISO45001 – Health & Safety

Our ISO45001 consultants in Kent can offer advice on creating clear health and safety processes within your organisation, as per the framework of this essential standard. Achieving ISO45001 brings plenty of benefits, not least the peace of mind that your policies and procedures are legally compliant. But perhaps one of the most significant advantages of implementing an enhanced Occupational Health & Safety Management system is that it will inevitably improve your employees’ experience. By creating greater awareness of workplace risks, it will also reduce absenteeism through fewer onsite accidents and work-related ill health.

Also available: ISO 42001 for artificial intelligence

How we work

What working with us actually involves

The same six things on every project, whichever standard you are going for.

  • Gap analysis, so you know where you stand before you commit to anything
  • Process mapping, and the improvements that fall out of it
  • Document creation — building and refining your systems
  • Training for your team, delivered at your premises
  • Internal auditing and management review meetings
  • Support during assessment visits, and afterwards

Why UKAS accreditation matters

Not every certificate is issued by an accredited body, and buyers are increasingly checking. Every client we have taken through registration has been certified by a UKAS approved body.
